resources.string: Apply to save and update Home. Turn off the override and apply to restore the code configuration. Drag and fling share one speed limit; 0 allows idle only. Stopping checks once immediately, with no idle polling.
Enhanced Home sliding window (off by default)

Off: prepare up to 2 visible entries after scrolling stops. On: use visible and adjacent rows with up to 9 unfinished tasks, subject to scroll speed. This may improve first-frame time, especially after a cold start. Continued scrolling may use more data, CPU and other resources. The task limit is not a total data cap; measure the trade-off for your app.
